ns2:course.label: Senior Design I
ns2:course.description: Capstone bioengineering design activity to develop solutions to projects provided by academia, industry, or clinical settings, utilizing principles of design, engineering analysis, and functional operation of engineering systems. Concept-design, safety, human-factors, quality, and Six-Sigma considerations. Initial solution proposals meeting professional technical-writing and communication standards. Concluded in BIOE 436. No graduate hours. Prerequisite: BIOE 301, BIOE 414, and BIOE 415.
